# RowPredicate

<link-summary>Decides whether a row is one to act on.</link-summary>

<web-summary>RowPredicate — Decides whether a row is one to act on. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
type RowPredicate = (
```

It receives the row's cells, its one-based position and — when a header row was named — the row keyed by the column names, which is `null` otherwise. Returning `true` selects the row.

## Examples

### Shape

```javascript
const predicate = (values, position, record) => record?.status === "done";
```
